rationale: EO 9739 (June 20, 1946) prescribed travel and storage expense rules for employees moved back to the seat of government. Section 3 of EO 9834 (March 20, 1947, effective as of November 1, 1946) revokes it, except that it continues to apply, so long as necessary, to returns of departmental functions ordered before November 1, 1946 and incomplete on that date. The Federal Register catalog observation (revoked by EO 9834) and the 1989 codification observation agree on the revocation. The saved residue is limited to a finite wartime-return program of 1944 to 1946 and no held source shows it still running; it cannot reach 2026-10-14. When the saved applicability ended is not shown, so the lifecycle claim is blocked, but the order is not in force at the cutoff.
